definition: A family of standards governing data communications over cable television networks.
entry_text: A family of standards governing data communications over cable television networks.
example: A cable modem exchanges broadband data with the operator's network using a supported DOCSIS version.
label: DOCSIS

sources.note: CableLabs identifies the document as a member of the DOCSIS high-speed data-over-cable specification family and depicts the cable modem linked to the operator’s broadband access network.
